## What changed

Describe the behavior you changed. Name the affected components and any relevant issues.

## Why

Explain the problem and why this approach is appropriate.

## Verification

List the exact commands you ran and their results. For checks you could not run, say why. Do not claim tests passed unless you ran them.

## Risks and limitations

Describe unsupported behavior, correctness risks, and compatibility limits. For performance changes, include the baseline, hardware, workload, measurement method, and any regressions.

## Review checklist

- [ ] I read and can explain every changed line, including code written with AI assistance.
- [ ] I checked memory ownership, error paths, and architecture-specific behavior where relevant.
- [ ] I added or updated meaningful tests, or explained why tests do not apply.
- [ ] The results above reflect checks I actually ran.
- [ ] I reviewed the diff for unrelated changes, unnecessary abstractions, and generated artifacts.
- [ ] Comments and documentation explain real behavior without filler or unsupported claims.
- [ ] The commits are focused and understandable.
- [ ] I followed [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
